heroHeadline: JNIM Overruns Djibo in 9-Hour Occupation — 100+ Killed in Largest Burkina Faso Attack; Russia's Africa Corps Humiliated in CNN Analysis; Mali Junta Dissolves All Parties
heroSubtitle: JNIM launched its largest ever operation in Burkina Faso on May 11, 2026: hundreds of fighters overran Djibo — the Sahel Region's provincial capital — from 5AM to 2PM in a 9-hour occupation. Targets hit included the army base (seized and looted), gendarmerie HQ, police HQ, a medical centre, a pharmacy, and the market. A Burkinabe fighter jet turned back under JNIM fire; drones were not deployed. Over 100 soldiers, VDP volunteers, and civilians were killed. International Crisis Group called it a 'major jihadist attack exposing military failings.' On May 10, CNN published a major analysis documenting how FLA fighters openly jeered Africa Corps soldiers during their Kidal withdrawal — 'Putin's regional grip is slipping.' Mali's junta simultaneously dissolved all political parties via decree; opposition figures El Bachir Thiam and Abba Alhassane were forcibly disappeared on May 9 alongside Mountaga Tall (missing since May 3).
